title: papaver somniferum var. leucum
intro: Papaver somniferum var. leucum, commonly known as white poppy, is a variety of opium poppy plant. It is a flowering plant that has been used for medicinal and ornamental purposes. The health benefits of white poppy include its potential to reduce anxiety and insomnia, while also exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of white poppy include alkaloids such as thebaine, codeine, and morphine, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedation, pain relief, and cough suppression, although its opium alkaloids are still being researched for their potential therapeutic uses.
